identity.name: Rollout
identity.one_line_description: Rollout is a board game café website that invites visitors to explore a curated library of games, book a table, join a vibrant community, and buy their favourite titles to take home.
identity.target_audience: Casual and hobby gamers aged 18–40, friend groups and couples looking for social outings, and families seeking screen-free entertainment who want a welcoming space to discover, play, and purchase board games.

sections.intent: Explain the Game Guide service — a unique human differentiator that removes the intimidation barrier and makes any visitor feel welcome regardless of experience.
sections.headline: Never Stare at a Rulebook Alone Again.
sections.body: Every table at Rollout has access to a trained Game Guide — a staff member who lives and breathes tabletop. Tell them your group size, how long you want to play, and whether you're in the mood for laughs or brain-burning strategy. They'll bring you the perfect game, teach you the rules in under five minutes, and check in throughout your session. No intimidation. No confusion. Just play.

sections.intent: Remove friction and answer the most common pre-visit questions so visitors feel fully prepared and confident to book.
sections.headline: Everything You Need Before You Visit.

items.title: Is there a game hire fee?
items.description: Yes — we charge a small per-person table fee that covers unlimited game access for your session. It's included in your booking.

items.title: Can I bring my own game?
items.description: Absolutely. Bring your own game and play for free — we only ask that you still purchase a drink or snack.

items.title: How long can we stay?
items.description: Standard bookings are 2 hours, but you can extend in 30-minute increments if space allows. Walk-ins are welcome during quieter hours.

items.title: Do you cater for large groups?
items.description: Yes! Groups of 8 or more should book one of our private event rooms. See our events page or contact us directly.

items.title: Can I buy games to take home?
items.description: Yes — many titles from our library are available to purchase in our in-café shop and online store.

sections.intent: Tell the origin story of Rollout — who founded it, why, and what they believe — to build brand affinity and human connection.
sections.headline: We Built the Café We Always Wished Existed.
sections.body: Rollout started at a kitchen table. Two friends, a copy of Pandemic, and a shared frustration that there was nowhere in the city to play great games with great people. So we found a space, filled it with shelves, trained a team of game obsessives, and opened the doors. That was three years ago. Since then, thousands of players have sat across from each other, laughed, argued, strategised, and left with new friends. We're not a bar with a few games on a shelf. We're a place built entirely around the joy of play.
